exposure: Placental area in the lower uterine segment
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 141 pregnant women (median age 32, range 24-40 years) with complete placenta previa
finding: Large placental area and short cervical length were associated with a higher risk of massive intraoperative hemorrhage (MIH) and adverse maternal-fetal perinatal outcomes in patients with complete placenta previa.
